reason: Automates recovery of active goal-driven sessions after a DSH restart by restoring agents, reauthorizing eligible goals, and continuing remaining execution rounds while skipping paused, blocked, and completed goals.

summaries.zh: 这是一个在 DSH 重启后自动恢复智能体并续跑活跃目标会话的自动化插件。
summaries.en: An automation plugin that restores agents and resumes active goal-driven sessions after a DSH restart.

capabilities: Scans persisted sessions for active goals after startup
Resumes agents and re-arms active goals automatically
Continues goal-driven agent execution without a new user instruction
May allow resumed tasks to write files or call external APIs
